content: Hi! Just starting Lean 4, self-taught (AI and regulation background). I noticed (n + 0 = n) closes by rfl, but (0 + n = n) does not. My mental model: Nat.add recurses on the second argument, so (n + 0) reduces definitionally while (0 + n) gets stuck on the variable (n). Is that right? And is induction n the idiomatic proof? Thanks!
This is correct. Induction is idiomatic proof if you are in a restricted environment (e.g. Lean Game). In real application, simp tactic will close this

Thanks Weiyi! Verified locally: simp closes it in one line and from scratch induction n with | zero => rfl | succ k ih => rw [Nat.add_succ, ih] works too. Good to know the split between the teaching setting and real use
